title: Sherlock Holmes: A Study in Scarlet — Ep 07/14 — "Light in the Darkness"
description:
A Study in Scarlet, Episode 7. A second man is dead, and Holmes asks for a dog.

Told in Watson's own voice, cut to under three minutes. Lestrade comes up the stairs with news that knocks the whiskey clean out of Gregson's hand: Joseph Stangerson has been found at Halliday's Private Hotel, stabbed under an open window, with that word written above the bed in dried blood. A milk boy saw a ladder raised to the window at first light, and a tall man in a long brown coat come down it and walk away without hurrying. The killer had stayed to wash his hands.

Among the dead man's things, a small chip box with two pills in it.

Holmes sends for the landlady's old terrier, cuts one pill in two and gives it in milk. Nothing happens. Minute follows minute, and the two detectives begin to enjoy themselves — until he goes at the box again and cuts the second.

Then a tap at the door: the cab has come. Holmes kneels over a portmanteau he has never mentioned, and asks the driver for a hand with the strap.

Chapter VII of Arthur Conan Doyle's A Study in Scarlet (1887), in the public domain.

— The Keeper's Lantern —
Every episode is one whole chapter, in order, from the first page to the last.
